title: New objects and functions break memo

slides.say: You wrapped a slow child in memo, but it still re-renders every time. Check the props.
Memo compares each prop with Object dot is. A new object or function every render is never equal to the old one.
Cache them in the parent with use memo and use callback. Or simplify the props: pass name and age directly as primitives.

slides.text: One "always new" prop breaks memo for the whole component.
slides.say: Remember: a single always new prop is enough to break memo for the whole component.
